comments: Accessibility Audit is an online WCAG 2.2 accessibility evaluation tool developed by AI Web Page SEO. It evaluates rendered web pages using custom accessibility checks and selected ACT-associated axe-core rules. The tool reports coverage of all 55 WCAG 2.2 Level A and AA success criteria, distinguishing automated findings from criteria requiring human evaluation. Published ACT technical documentation and test evidence are available at https://aiwebpageseo.com/accessibility-act-rules.html. Recorded verification includes 38/38 official ACT text-spacing examples matched, 30/30 regression tests passed and 6/6 W3C readiness checks passed. Reports include accessibility findings, scores and guidance. Automated results are not presented as certification of full WCAG conformance.
features: Accessibility Audit evaluates websites against WCAG 2.2 A/AA using automated rendered-browser checks, including keyboard navigation, focus, contrast, reflow and text spacing. It assesses multiple pages, generates reports with findings and guidance, and identifies accessibility criteria requiring human verification.
title: Accessibility Audit
